items.title: ALPS: Measuring Valid Creativity in Large Language Models with Mathematical Construction
items.abstract_or_text: Large language models produce outputs presented as discoveries - new proofs, conjectures, or molecules. Whether such an output that appears creative is truly original and effective is hard to establish: open-ended outputs require subjective judgment, the output may replicate something seen in training, or the task may be too simple to need creativity. We present ALPS (Austin-Law Proof-Synthesis), a benchmark that designs a task to measure valid creativity: producing a solution that is original and can be proven correct. Each instance is a single equational law, certified to require either the construction of an infinite mathematical structure satisfying the law, or a proof that no such structure exists. Submissions are verified by automated proof checking with no human involvement, and a public generator produces new instances without limit, so LLMs are never evaluated on problems they may have seen. A portfolio of eight configurations of leading automated provers resolves 2.2% of the 4,141-law evaluation pool, and a twentyfold budget increase adds 0.6%: the obstacle is not compute, but the absence of any method that produces the tailored structure each law requires. Under a fixed protocol, the strongest reasoning model we test succeeds in 14% of instances on the proof side, but none on the construction side. The remaining 97.2% of the pool is unresolved at every configuration and budget we test. We release ALPS in full: the corpus, the generator, and the automated judge.
items.summary_zh: ALPS 以可自动判定的代数律任务，测试模型能否构造满足条件的无限数学结构，或证明这类结构不存在。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 任务生成器和自动证明检查器降低了训练数据记忆与人工主观评分的影响，也揭示现有模型在“构造”一侧仍明显受限。
items.abstract_zh: 大语言模型会产生被表述为发现的输出——新的证明、猜想或分子。要确定这种看似有创造性的输出是否真正原创且有效十分困难：开放式输出需要主观判断，输出可能复现训练中见过的内容，或者任务本身过于简单而无须创造力。我们提出 ALPS（Austin-Law Proof-Synthesis），这是一个旨在测量有效创造力的基准：生成既原创又能被证明正确的解。每个实例是一条单独的等式律，并经认证，要求要么构造一个满足该律的无限数学结构，要么证明不存在这样的结构。提交结果通过自动化证明检查验证，无需人工参与；公开生成器可以无限产生新实例，因此 LLM 不会在它们可能见过的问题上被评估。八种领先自动证明器配置组成的组合解决了 4,141 条律评估池中的 2.2%；将预算增加二十倍仅多解决 0.6%：障碍不在算力，而在于没有能产生每条律所需定制结构的方法。在固定协议下，我们测试的最强推理模型在证明一侧成功解决了 14% 的实例，但在构造一侧一个也未解决。我们在所有测试配置和预算下均未解决的评估池占 97.2%。我们完整发布 ALPS：语料、生成器和自动判定器。
items.author_line: Eric Xie, Wenqian Ye, Aidong Zhang

items.title: Ask, Condition or Abstain: Reinforcement Learning for Missing-Premise Reasoning
items.abstract_or_text: Answer-only reinforcement learning (RL) trains reasoning models to solve fully specified problems, but many realistic queries omit a premise needed for a unique answer. In this setting, the useful response is not always refusal: the model should ask for the missing premise, condition its answer on the unknown quantity, or abstain when no informative conditional response is available. We present Ask-Condition-Abstain Reinforcement Learning (ACA-RL), a data-augmented RL framework for this setting. Its reasoning-graph-guided pipeline converts well-posed problems into missing-premise training instances with localized gap annotations; ACA-RL then trains on these instances with a structured reward over five observable response behaviors. We also introduce the Missing-Premise Benchmark (MPB), a 274-instance human-verified benchmark spanning mathematical, logical, and real-world word problems. Across Qwen3 and Llama models, ACA-RL consistently improves on MPB while preserving competitive performance on well-posed reasoning tasks. Together with the released code, MPB, and training data, this work supports a new mission for NLP evaluation: measuring whether models can recognize when a task is underdetermined and handle uncertainty, not only whether they can answer fully specified questions.
items.summary_zh: ACA-RL 训练模型在题目前提缺失时选择追问、给出条件式答案或弃答，并发布覆盖数学、逻辑和现实文字题的 MPB。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它把识别不定问题作为可测任务，避免将给出貌似确定的答案误当作数学推理能力。
items.abstract_zh: 仅以答案为目标的强化学习（RL）训练推理模型解决信息完备的问题，但许多真实查询缺少获得唯一答案所需的前提。在这种情况下，有用的回应并不总是拒答：模型应当询问缺失前提、将答案条件化于未知量，或者在无法给出有信息量的条件式回应时弃答。我们提出 Ask-Condition-Abstain Reinforcement Learning（ACA-RL），这是一种面向该情形的数据增强 RL 框架。其由推理图引导的流程将良定问题转化为带有局部缺口标注的缺失前提训练实例；ACA-RL 随后以涵盖五种可观察回应行为的结构化奖励进行训练。我们还提出 Missing-Premise Benchmark（MPB），这是一个包含 274 个经人工核验实例的基准，覆盖数学、逻辑和现实世界文字问题。在 Qwen3 和 Llama 模型上，ACA-RL 一贯改善了 MPB 表现，同时在良定推理任务上保持有竞争力的性能。连同发布的代码、MPB 和训练数据，这项工作支持 NLP 评估的一项新使命：衡量模型能否认识到任务何时不定，并处理不确定性，而不只是衡量它们能否回答信息完备的问题。

items.title: Does the Proof Prove It That Way? Faithful Formalization of Elements Proofs
items.abstract_or_text: In formal verification, both the autoformalization of statements and automated proof search have been studied extensively. While automated proof search can produce a formal proof that compiles, the generated proof does not necessarily reflect how the natural-language argument arrives at its conclusion--a property we refer to as faithfulness. With faithfully formalized proofs, one can check the reasoning behind a human- or AI-written argument, and assist mathematicians in formalizing their proof sketches. However, it is particularly challenging due to misalignment of formal proof tactics and natural language reasoning. In this work, we rigorously describe a set of five necessary conditions a faithful formal proof must satisfy, and introduce Pistis, an agentic, oracle-guided proof search that produces formal Lean proofs that satisfy them. At its core is a novel faithfulness-preserving divide-and-conquer search, which we name OrderDecompose, that tracks citation dependencies and blocks unfaithful shortcuts, paired with a refutation search, that surfaces gaps and errors in the natural language proof source. OrderDecompose completes proofs that baselines cannot close even within a 12-hour budget, and its artifacts compile over 33\times as fast as prior work's. We apply Pistis on the first three books of Euclid's Elements, producing high-quality artifacts containing faithful formal proofs. Under a blinded human study and an LLM-as-a-judge protocol on rigorous rubrics, Pistis-generated proofs are favored over prior works--2.89\times and 5.2\times as often by human reviewers and the LLM judge, respectively. It further uncovers gaps in Euclid's proofs and their translation, and can accept or refute natural language proofs written by humans or AI, demonstrating that faithful formalization is useful as a proof-checking tool.
items.summary_zh: Pistis 使用 OrderDecompose 搜索 Lean 证明，并以五项必要条件约束形式证明与自然语言论证之间的忠实性。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 可编译不等于忠实复现原证明。该工作将论证依赖、反驳搜索和 Lean 工件结合，面向可检查的自动形式化。
items.abstract_zh: 在形式化验证中，陈述的自动形式化和自动证明搜索都已得到广泛研究。尽管自动证明搜索能够产生可编译的形式证明，生成的证明却未必反映自然语言论证如何得出结论——我们将这一性质称为忠实性。借助忠实形式化的证明，人们可以检查人类或 AI 所写论证背后的推理，并帮助数学家将证明提纲形式化。然而，这一任务尤其困难，因为形式证明策略与自然语言推理之间存在不对齐。在本工作中，我们严格描述了忠实形式证明必须满足的五个必要条件，并提出 Pistis：一种由预言机引导的智能体式证明搜索方法，可生成满足这些条件的正式 Lean 证明。其核心是一种保持忠实性的分治搜索，我们称为 OrderDecompose；它追踪引用依赖并阻止不忠实的捷径，同时配合反驳搜索，暴露自然语言证明来源中的缺口和错误。OrderDecompose 能完成基线方法即使在 12 小时预算内也无法完成的证明，其生成工件的编译速度比先前工作快 33 倍以上。我们将 Pistis 应用于 Euclid《Elements》的前三卷，生成包含忠实形式证明的高质量工件。在盲法人工研究和采用严格量规的 LLM 评审协议中，人类评审者和 LLM 评审者对 Pistis 所生成证明的偏好分别是先前工作的 2.89 倍和 5.2 倍。它还发现了 Euclid 证明及其译文中的缺口，并能够接受或反驳由人类或 AI 写成的自然语言证明，表明忠实形式化可作为证明检查工具发挥作用。
items.author_line: Tadd Mao, Tianjun Zhong, Dhruva Arekar, Yuming Feng, One An, Jiani Huang, Xujie Si, Ziyang Li

items.title: MetaReason: Precise Interleaved Multimodal Reasoning via Editing Meta Information for Solving Geometry Problems
items.abstract_or_text: Although visual reasoning is crucial for solving complex geometry tasks, existing vision-language models rely heavily on text-only reasoning. Some recent methods introduce intermediate visual states to facilitate reasoning, but they are often hindered by inaccurate geometric representations and low rendering fidelity, ultimately leading to unreliable outputs. To address these limitations, we propose MetaReason, a framework for multimodal reasoning in plane geometry that leverages structured meta-information to enable accurate auxiliary-line construction. The framework first parses geometric images into meta-information, performs controllable edits with predefined tools to synthesize high-fidelity visual states, and then conducts reasoning based on these augmented views. To support this framework, we construct TutorGeo, a comprehensive dataset containing 17k image-to-meta conversion samples, 60k text-only reasoning traces, and 60k interleaved multimodal reasoning traces. Using this dataset, we combine supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning to develop robust multimodal reasoning capabilities. We also introduce ExamGeo, a benchmark derived from real-world examination problems that enables systematic evaluation across varying difficulty levels. Experimental results demonstrate that MetaReason significantly outperforms existing open-source models and achieves competitive performance against proprietary models.
items.summary_zh: MetaReason 通过结构化几何元信息和可控辅助线编辑，进行交错的视觉—文本平面几何推理，并提供 TutorGeo 与 ExamGeo。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它将图形解析、辅助线构造和题目评测显式连接，便于检验多模态系统的几何结论是否依赖正确的图形状态。
items.abstract_zh: 尽管视觉推理对于解决复杂几何任务至关重要，现有视觉语言模型仍高度依赖纯文本推理。一些近期方法引入中间视觉状态以促进推理，但它们往往受不准确的几何表征和较低渲染保真度限制，最终导致不可靠的输出。为解决这些限制，我们提出 MetaReason：一个用于平面几何多模态推理的框架，利用结构化元信息实现准确的辅助线构造。该框架首先将几何图像解析为元信息，利用预定义工具进行可控编辑以合成高保真视觉状态，随后基于这些增强视图开展推理。为支持该框架，我们构建 TutorGeo，这是一个综合数据集，包含 1.7 万个图像到元信息转换样本、6 万条纯文本推理轨迹和 6 万条交错多模态推理轨迹。利用该数据集，我们结合监督微调和强化学习来发展稳健的多模态推理能力。我们还提出 ExamGeo，这是一个由真实考试题衍生的基准，可在不同难度级别上进行系统评估。实验结果表明，MetaReason 显著优于现有开源模型，并在与闭源模型的比较中达到有竞争力的表现。
items.author_line: Penghao Yin, Haomin Wang, Qihong Tang, Xiaoye Qu, Hongjie Zhang, Xiao-Ping Zhang

items.title: Certified but Private: Scalable Zero-Knowledge Proofs for Neural Network Guarantees
items.abstract_or_text: With the growing deployment of machine learning models, formal guarantees of the robustness and fairness of these models have become increasingly important in safety-critical and legal-compliance settings. However, model parameters are often commercial secrets that cannot be disclosed to auditors or end users. To this end, we present PANDA, a scalable system that uses zero-knowledge proofs (ZKPs) to prove the robustness and fairness properties of a model without revealing its private parameters. PANDA is built on top of CROWN, an efficient robustness certification framework that is used in many state-of-the-art formal verification tools for neural networks. The core contribution of PANDA is a novel algorithm for proving linear relaxation bounds for non-linear activation layers, yielding simple, lightweight proofs. Remarkably, our system can generate proofs of local robustness for neural networks with more than 2.9M parameters in 5 minutes, and can verify them in 10 seconds. Prior ZKP-based robustness system rely on exponential-time algorithms that cannot scale to nontrivial networks. In contrast, PANDA scales polynomially in the number of neurons in a network, allowing us to support neural networks 4 orders of magnitude larger than previous approaches with significantly reduced prover overhead.
items.summary_zh: PANDA 将 CROWN 的神经网络认证结果转化为零知识证明，使审计者可验证鲁棒性和公平性而无需获得私有模型参数。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它把神经网络保证的可验证性与模型保密需求结合，并报告了证明生成和验证时间，结果可由验证者独立检查。
items.abstract_zh: 随着机器学习模型部署日益增多，模型鲁棒性和公平性的形式保证在安全关键和法律合规场景中变得愈发重要。然而，模型参数通常是不能向审计者或终端用户披露的商业秘密。为此，我们提出 PANDA：一个利用零知识证明（ZKP）在不泄露私有参数的情况下证明模型鲁棒性和公平性性质的可扩展系统。PANDA 构建于 CROWN 之上，后者是一种高效的鲁棒性认证框架，被许多最先进的神经网络形式验证工具使用。PANDA 的核心贡献是一种为非线性激活层证明线性松弛界的新算法，可产生简单、轻量的证明。值得注意的是，我们的系统能够在 5 分钟内为参数量超过 290 万的神经网络生成局部鲁棒性证明，并在 10 秒内完成验证。先前基于 ZKP 的鲁棒性系统依赖指数时间算法，无法扩展到非平凡网络。相比之下，PANDA 的规模随网络神经元数呈多项式增长，使其支持的神经网络比先前方法大 4 个数量级，同时显著降低证明者开销。
items.author_line: Youwei Zhong, Ben Merbaum, Timos Antonopoulos, Ning Luo, Charalampos Papamanthou, Katerina Sotiraki, Ruzica Piskac

items.title: R^3-Bench: LLMs Struggle with Resource-Rational Reasoning under Shared Budgets
items.abstract_or_text: In cognitive science, resource rationality asks how an agent should allocate limited computation to maximize expected value. Most reasoning and agent benchmarks use independent per-task budgets; existing shared-budget studies do not calibrate suite performance against the same model's demonstrated single-problem competence. We introduce R^3-Bench, which evaluates six-problem suites under shared budgets across mathematics, competitive programming, and abstract reasoning in tool-free and agentic settings. Matched single-problem response curves define an offline empirical oracle over observed successes. Across 72 main-table cells for six models, the oracle mean matches or exceeds the contest mean in all cells and is strictly higher in 71. Under moderate tool-free pressure, equal-allocation replay also exceeds contest performance for four of six models. Trajectory diagnostics reveal limited strategy updating and pressure-dependent failure patterns. In a three-model diagnostic under strong agentic pressure, at least one fixed scheduler exceeds the contest mean in six of nine cells, but no policy dominates across domains. These results expose a persistent gap between demonstrated competence and shared-budget realization.
items.summary_zh: R³-Bench 在共享计算预算下测试模型如何分配六道题的推理资源，并以同一模型的单题表现构建经验比较基准。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它显示单题成绩不能直接代表多题资源调度能力，且使用数学、竞赛编程和抽象推理中的对照与诊断来支持这一结论。
items.abstract_zh: 在认知科学中，资源理性研究智能体应如何分配有限计算以最大化预期价值。大多数推理和智能体基准使用彼此独立的单题预算；现有共享预算研究并未将整套任务表现校准到同一模型已经展示的单题能力。我们提出 R³-Bench，它在无工具和智能体设置下，评估跨数学、竞赛编程和抽象推理的六题任务组，并施加共享预算。匹配的单题响应曲线定义了一个基于已观察成功案例的离线经验预言机。在六个模型的 72 个主表单元中，预言机均值在所有单元中都达到或超过竞赛均值，并在其中 71 个单元严格更高。在中等无工具压力下，平均分配重放也超过了六个模型中四个模型的竞赛表现。轨迹诊断揭示了有限的策略更新和随压力变化的失败模式。在强智能体压力下的三模型诊断中，至少一种固定调度器在九个单元中的六个超过竞赛均值，但没有一种策略在各领域均占优。这些结果揭示了已展示能力与共享预算实现之间持续存在的差距。
items.author_line: Peisong Wang, Zhiwei Ma, Bowen Liu, Feixue Liu, Aochuan Chen, Chenyi Zi, Hongchuan Zeng, Yuhan Li, Jia Li

items.title: Time to Reason: Scalable Neurosymbolic Learning for LTLf via Fuzzy Semantics
items.abstract_or_text: Neurosymbolic (NeSy) Artificial Intelligence aims to integrate Deep Learning (DL) architectures with symbolic reasoning. While initial NeSy approaches have targeted mainly symbolic reasoning in propositional and first-order logics, recent works have started to address the construction of neurosymbolic frameworks for Temporal Logics, and in particular for LTLf. These approaches have established temporal NeSy as a promising research direction, laying the foundations for learning under temporal constraints. Nonetheless, they leave many questions unanswered. From a theoretical perspective, several differentiable semantics for interpreting LTLf have been proposed but have not yet been formally and systematically defined within a unified framework. Moreover, existing approaches commonly rely on automata to represent temporal knowledge, resulting in limited scalability. Motivated by this research gap, this paper provides the following contributions: (i) formally defining different fuzzy semantics for LTLf, and systematically analysing theoretical properties regarding equivalences and dualities of temporal operators; (ii) showing how these semantics can be directly integrated within a novel NeSy framework, called DiffLTLf, enabling flexible and scalable learning without relying on the usage of automata; and (iii) introducing a novel evaluation protocol of increased complexity of learning tasks w.r.t. existing benchmarks. Our results show that the choice of fuzzy semantics has a significant impact on predictive performance. Moreover, DiffLTLf achieves performance on par with, and sometimes superior to, state-of-the-art probabilistic approaches while substantially improving scalability. Taken together, these results establish direct fuzzy interpretations as a competitive and scalable alternative to existing temporal NeSy frameworks.
items.summary_zh: 该研究统一定义 LTLf 的多种模糊语义，分析时序算子的等价性与对偶性，并以 DiffLTLf 进行可微神经符号学习。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 形式性质分析与逐步提高难度的评测协议，使模糊时序逻辑的学习结果可以与概率方法进行具体比较。
items.abstract_zh: 神经符号（NeSy）人工智能旨在整合深度学习（DL）架构与符号推理。早期 NeSy 方法主要面向命题逻辑和一阶逻辑中的符号推理，近期工作则开始构建针对时序逻辑、尤其是 LTLf 的神经符号框架。这些方法确立了时序 NeSy 这一有前景的研究方向，并为时序约束下的学习奠定基础，但仍留下许多未解问题。从理论角度看，已有多种用于解释 LTLf 的可微语义被提出，却尚未在统一框架内得到正式且系统的定义。此外，现有方法通常依赖自动机表征时序知识，因而可扩展性有限。针对这一研究缺口，本文作出如下贡献：（i）正式定义 LTLf 的不同模糊语义，并系统分析时序算子等价性和对偶性等理论性质；（ii）展示如何将这些语义直接整合到一种名为 DiffLTLf 的新型 NeSy 框架中，在不依赖自动机的情况下实现灵活且可扩展的学习；（iii）引入一种相较现有基准、学习任务复杂度更高的新评测协议。结果表明，模糊语义的选择对预测性能有显著影响。此外，DiffLTLf 的性能与最先进概率方法相当，有时更优，同时大幅提升可扩展性。总体而言，这些结果确立了直接模糊解释作为现有时序 NeSy 框架的一种有竞争力且可扩展的替代方案。
items.author_line: Riccardo Andreoni, Andrei Buliga, Alessandro Daniele, Paolo Felli, Chiara Ghidini, Marco Montali, Massimiliano Ronzani

items.title: Temporal Logic Guided Universal Task Representations for Reinforcement Learning
items.abstract_or_text: Task guided agents demonstrate strong performance in a wide range of complex tasks. However, most existing task representation algorithms are tailored to specific contexts and struggle to generalize across diverse scenarios. Moreover, they typically depend on gradient signals from reinforcement learning controllers to update their weights, which can degrade both representation quality and learning efficiency. To overcome these limitations, we propose LOTUS, a temporal logic inspired universal task representation framework that can be seamlessly integrated into any RL algorithm to enhance agent performance across diverse task settings. Specifically, we design a novel task representation architecture capable of modeling relationships and extracting task semantics from LTL formulas. We further introduce a more effective update mechanism that treats the LTL encoder as a policy, thereby improving representation capacity. To enhance stability and robustness, LOTUS leverages the bisimulation metric, which provides theoretical guarantees for LTL representation, including behavioral equivalence, optimality fidelity, and trajectory robustness. Experimental results show that LOTUS outperforms most existing methods in learning efficiency, generalization capability, and representation quality. Specifically, LOTUS accelerates convergence over 20% in single-task scenarios, achieves a 15%-45% higher success rate in unseen manipulation tasks, and improves generalization performance over 25% in complex multi-task environments with increased sub-goal depth or conjunctions. The corresponding code, videos, and appendix are available at: https://lotus-website.github.io/.
items.summary_zh: LOTUS 以 LTL 公式编码任务语义，并借助双模拟度量给出任务表示的行为等价、最优性保真和轨迹鲁棒性保证。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它把时序逻辑任务规格用于强化学习表示学习，同时用未见操控任务的结果检验泛化，而非只报告单一环境得分。
items.abstract_zh: 任务引导智能体在广泛的复杂任务中表现强劲。然而，大多数现有任务表示算法针对特定场景设计，难以泛化到多样环境。此外，它们通常依赖强化学习控制器的梯度信号更新权重，这会降低表示质量和学习效率。为克服这些限制，我们提出 LOTUS：一种受时序逻辑启发的通用任务表示框架，可无缝整合到任意 RL 算法中，以提升智能体在多样任务设置下的性能。具体而言，我们设计了一种新颖任务表示架构，能够从 LTL 公式中建模关系并提取任务语义。我们进一步提出一种更有效的更新机制，将 LTL 编码器视为策略，从而提高表示能力。为增强稳定性和鲁棒性，LOTUS 利用双模拟度量，它为 LTL 表示提供理论保证，包括行为等价性、最优性保真度和轨迹鲁棒性。实验结果表明，LOTUS 在学习效率、泛化能力和表示质量方面优于大多数现有方法。具体而言，LOTUS 在单任务场景中将收敛速度提高超过 20%，在未见操控任务上获得高出 15%–45% 的成功率，并在具有更深子目标或合取的复杂多任务环境中将泛化性能提高超过 25%。相应代码、视频和附录可在 https://lotus-website.github.io/ 获取。
items.author_line: Hao Zhang, Zhangli Zhou, Zhen Kan

items.title: T-LLM Compiler: Trusted LLM-based Code Optimization and Verification Framework
items.abstract_or_text: Recent advances in Large Language Models (LLMs) have opened opportunities to apply high-level code transformations to the field of code optimization, and it has since emerged as one of the most fundamental tasks for LLMs to perform; however, at present, LLMs struggle to apply wide-ranging code optimization tasks due to both the complexity of the code and the inability to independently verify the correctness of the transformations. In this paper, we present the Trusted LLM (T-LLM) Compiler, which proposes an advancement in compiler technology through a collaborative effort involving high-level LLM code transformations, traditional compilers, and verification tools. Experimental results reveal that it can significantly improve code correctness when tested on a set of PolyBench/C benchmarks. Our approach facilitates iterative code optimization efforts with verification strategies that enable corrective actions. Through this approach, T-LLM Compiler achieves code optimization accuracy of up to 83.3% and a speedup of up to 16.1\% on the PolyBench/C benchmarks, with the transformed code reaching an average of 26.7% speedup wrt standard baselines. Additionally, we release the project's source code to the open-source community.
items.summary_zh: T-LLM Compiler 将 LLM 代码变换、传统编译器和验证工具结合，用于带正确性检查的代码优化。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 其 PolyBench/C 实验同时报告变换正确率和加速比，说明模型生成的优化需经过外部工具检验。
items.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）的近期进展为将高层代码变换应用于代码优化领域带来了机会，代码优化也由此成为 LLM 执行的最基础任务之一；但目前，LLM 仍难以完成覆盖范围广的代码优化任务，原因既在于代码的复杂性，也在于其无法独立验证变换的正确性。本文提出 Trusted LLM（T-LLM）Compiler，通过高层 LLM 代码变换、传统编译器和验证工具的协同推进编译器技术。实验结果显示，在一组 PolyBench/C 基准上测试时，该方法能够显著提高代码正确性。我们的方法促进了带有验证策略的迭代码优化工作，从而能够采取纠正性动作。借助这一方法，T-LLM Compiler 的代码优化正确率最高达到 83.3%，在 PolyBench/C 基准上最高获得 16.1% 的加速；变换后代码相对于标准基线平均加速 26.7%。此外，我们向开源社区发布了项目源代码。
items.author_line: Zahra Fazel, Sunanda Gamage, Shayan Shirahmad Gale Bagi, Amir H. Ashouri, Tomasz S. Czajkowski, Bryan Chan, Reza Azimi, Yaoqing Gao

items.title: PDDLCoder: Agentic PDDL Generation for LLM-Assisted Symbolic Planning
items.abstract_or_text: LLMs remain unreliable for long-horizon planning, often generating logically inconsistent or non-applicable plans. Recent hybrid methods instead translate natural language into the Planning Domain Definition Language (PDDL), allowing symbolic planners to produce verifiable plans. However, existing methods frequently rely on rigid generation pipelines, a partial PDDL definition, or human feedback. Furthermore, their evaluation is hindered by the lack of standardized benchmarks with automated verification. To address these limitations, we present PDDLCoder, an agentic framework for PDDL generation from natural language that iteratively generates, analyzes, and refines planning specifications. We further introduce NL-pddlgym, a benchmark dataset comprising 711 planning problems across 23 domains with executable gym environments for the automated verification of plan applicability. Experiments on the NL-pddlgym test set containing 106 problems across 4 held-out domains show that PDDLCoder generates applicable plans for 89.6\% of tested planning problems. This improves upon our adaptations of previous PDDL generation methods, which achieved up to 45.3\%, and outperforms direct LLM planning approaches, which reached up to 74.5\% on the same test set. Our work demonstrates the effectiveness of agentic PDDL generation for planning and establishes a reproducible benchmark for future research on LLM-assisted symbolic planning.
items.summary_zh: PDDLCoder 将自然语言迭代转换为 PDDL，并以可执行环境自动检查所生成计划是否适用。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它提供了含 711 个问题的 NL-pddlgym，以及留出领域上的自动验证结果，适合衡量语言模型辅助符号规划的可靠性。
items.abstract_zh: LLM 在长时程规划中仍不可靠，常会生成逻辑不一致或不可应用的计划。近期混合方法转而将自然语言翻译为规划领域定义语言（PDDL），让符号规划器产生可验证的计划。然而，现有方法常依赖僵化的生成流程、不完整的 PDDL 定义或人工反馈。此外，由于缺少带自动验证的标准化基准，它们的评测受到限制。为解决这些限制，我们提出 PDDLCoder：一种从自然语言生成 PDDL 的智能体式框架，可迭代地生成、分析和修订规划规格。我们还提出 NL-pddlgym，这是一个基准数据集，包含 23 个领域中的 711 个规划问题，并配有可用于自动验证计划适用性的可执行 gym 环境。在 NL-pddlgym 测试集上——该测试集包含 4 个留出领域中的 106 个问题——PDDLCoder 在 89.6% 的受测规划问题上生成了可应用的计划。这优于我们对既有 PDDL 生成方法的改造版本，后者最高达到 45.3%，也优于直接 LLM 规划方法，后者在相同测试集上最高达到 74.5%。本工作表明智能体式 PDDL 生成对规划是有效的，并为未来 LLM 辅助符号规划研究建立了可复现基准。
items.author_line: Veit Laule, Jiangtao Shuai, Manfred Hauswirth, Sonja Schimmler

items.title: RamseyGadgets: A Graph Construction Dataset for LLMs
items.abstract_or_text: Constructing special graphs is an important task within graph theory and computer science. Many popular graph constructions are the result of a comprehensive exploration of relevant graphs and human ingenuity. Given the rise of generative AI usage in mathematics, it is natural to test whether LLMs are able to construct graphs with specified properties using their reasoning capabilities. Unfortunately, many natural graph construction problems, such as finding extremal Ramsey-good graphs (i.e., avoiding specific monochromatic subgraphs), have been explored extensively in the literature, making it difficult to ascertain whether a construction is the product of an LLM's reasoning capabilities or its recollection from training data. In this work, we introduce RamseyGadgets, a novel dataset of 70 underexplored graph construction problems that require finding Ramsey-good graphs with special properties (e.g., containing an edge with a fixed color). These problems have reasonably sized solutions (at most 10 vertices) that can be verified by SAT solvers, making them suitable for automatic evaluation. Our dataset is easily expandable, as one can simply change the monochromatic subgraphs being avoided to obtain a new set of problems. We evaluate the performance of five open-source LLMs on our dataset and report the results. Our findings show that LLMs achieve only 37.70% accuracy on the hard-tier problems in our dataset, with Gemma-4-31B achieving the highest performance out of the five. We also showcase how our dataset allows us to ascertain what kind of hints help LLMs perform better at this task.
items.summary_zh: RamseyGadgets 提供 70 个较少被探索的 Ramsey-good 图构造题，可用 SAT 求解器自动核验。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 图构造答案规模受控、可自动验证，且任务可通过改变所避免的单色子图扩展，有助于减少以记忆替代推理的干扰。
items.abstract_zh: 构造具有特殊性质的图是图论和计算机科学中的一项重要任务。许多流行的图构造来自对相关图的全面探索和人类创造力。随着生成式 AI 在数学中的应用增加，人们自然会测试 LLM 能否利用其推理能力构造满足指定性质的图。不幸的是，许多自然的图构造问题，例如寻找极值 Ramsey-good 图（即避免特定单色子图的图），已经在文献中被广泛探索，因此很难确定某个构造是 LLM 推理能力的产物，还是其对训练数据的回忆。本文提出 RamseyGadgets：一个包含 70 个较少被探索的图构造问题的新数据集，要求找到具有特殊性质的 Ramsey-good 图（例如包含一条固定颜色的边）。这些问题具有大小适中的解（至多 10 个顶点），可由 SAT 求解器验证，因此适合自动评估。我们的数据集容易扩展：只需改变所避免的单色子图，即可得到新问题。我们在该数据集上评估五个开源 LLM 的表现并报告结果。研究发现，LLM 在数据集中高难度部分的准确率仅为 37.70%，五个模型中 Gemma-4-31B 的性能最高。我们还展示了该数据集如何帮助确定哪些类型的提示能帮助 LLM 在此任务上表现更好。
items.author_line: Zohair Raza Hassan, Deepak Pandita

items.title: SignalReasoner: Assessing the Upper Bound of 3B Models for Signal Mathematical Reasoning
items.abstract_or_text: Post-training with supervised chain-of-thought fine-tuning and reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards has substantially improved the mathematical reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs). However, their application to signal processing problems remains relatively under-explored. This report investigates reinforcement fine-tuning strategies for adapting Qwen2.5-3B-Base to graduate-level signal mathematical problems from WirelessMATHBench-XL, a comprehensive benchmark for mathematical reasoning in this domain. We examine two training paradigms: (i) direct reinforcement learning (RL) on WirelessMATHBench-XL with verifiable rewards; and (ii) supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on a distilled wireless-domain chain-of-thought corpus, followed by the same domain-specific RL stage. Across both paradigms, we benchmark Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), Group Sequence Policy Optimization (GSPO), and Geometric-Mean Policy Optimization (GMPO). We aim to assess whether domain-aware CoT SFT serves as an effective initialization for subsequent RL, and whether GSPO or GMPO offer advantages in stability or accuracy over GRPO for signal reasoning tasks. Our best model achieves an overall accuracy of 39.12\%, representing a more than threefold improvement over the untrained Base model (12.37\%).
items.summary_zh: SignalReasoner 比较多种可验证奖励强化学习方案，用于将 Qwen2.5-3B-Base 适配到 WirelessMATHBench-XL 的研究生信号数学题。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 研究报告了从未训练模型到最优模型的绝对准确率，并比较 GRPO、GSPO 与 GMPO，结果限定在明确定义的领域基准与训练设置中。
items.abstract_zh: 通过监督式思维链微调和来自可验证奖励的强化学习进行后训练，已显著提升大语言模型（LLM）的数学推理能力。然而，它们在信号处理问题上的应用仍相对缺乏探索。本报告研究针对 WirelessMATHBench-XL 中研究生层次信号数学问题，将 Qwen2.5-3B-Base 进行适配的强化微调策略；WirelessMATHBench-XL 是该领域一个综合性数学推理基准。我们考察两种训练范式：（i）在 WirelessMATHBench-XL 上以可验证奖励进行直接强化学习（RL）；（ii）先在蒸馏的无线领域思维链语料上进行监督微调（SFT），再进行相同的领域特定 RL 阶段。在两种范式中，我们均评测 Group Relative Policy Optimization（GRPO）、Group Sequence Policy Optimization（GSPO）和 Geometric-Mean Policy Optimization（GMPO）。我们的目标是评估领域感知的思维链 SFT 是否能作为后续 RL 的有效初始化，以及 GSPO 或 GMPO 是否在稳定性或准确率方面优于 GRPO。最佳模型的总体准确率达到 39.12%，相对于未经训练的 Base 模型（12.37%）提升超过三倍。
items.author_line: Guozheng Sun

items.title: OraclePhys: A Systematic Framework for LLM Fine-Tuning on Structural Mechanics
items.abstract_or_text: What a language model internalizes from fine-tuning is usually diagnosed after the fact. We make it an experimental variable. OraclePhys is a systematic fine-tuning framework with three components: OraclePhys-Bench, an exactly-graded structural-mechanics benchmark whose finite-element oracle scores every answer and counterfactual edit -- no human labels, no LLM judging; OraclePhys-30K, a supervision dataset of seven answer forms over byte-identical structure descriptions; and a controlled training study across the seven forms and three verifier roles. The study yields two findings. First, the label's answer form -- not its bit count -- causally determines what fine-tuning teaches: a ranking objective installs an out-of-distribution forward model where the untrained base sits at the guessing prior, a scalar objective at best a partial one, a boolean nothing detectable; the vector-scalar gulf survives a second physics domain, a second model family, and a paraphrased evaluation surface. Second, written or score-filtered answers install this capability, while advantage-weighted scores (GRPO) raise reward yet leave the model statistically equivalent to its start on held-out physics -- within the recipes and budgets tested -- sufficing only for routing. The trained 8B -- the first LLM on spatial structural response -- reaches the task's data-precision frontier: above a frontier LLM at zero- and 32-shot, at a specialist's level. What the label spells out about the target computation is what fine-tuning teaches; what you train on is what you route.
items.summary_zh: OraclePhys 用有限元预言机对结构力学答案及反事实编辑进行精确评分，并以受控训练研究不同监督答案形式的作用。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 评测不依赖人工标签或 LLM 裁判，且跨物理领域、模型家族和改写测试面检验结论，适合审视模型学习到的具体计算能力。
items.abstract_zh: 语言模型从微调中内化了什么，通常是在事后诊断。我们将其设为实验变量。OraclePhys 是一个系统化微调框架，包含三个部分：OraclePhys-Bench，一个由有限元预言机对每个答案和反事实编辑进行精确评分的结构力学基准——没有人工标签，也没有 LLM 评判；OraclePhys-30K，一个在字节完全相同的结构描述上包含七种答案形式的监督数据集；以及一项涵盖七种答案形式和三种验证器角色的受控训练研究。该研究得到两项发现。第一，标签的答案形式而非其比特数，因果地决定微调所教会的内容：排序目标会安装一个分布外前向模型，未训练基座模型处于猜测先验；标量目标至多安装部分能力；布尔目标没有检测到任何能力。向量与标量的差距在第二个物理领域、第二个模型家族和改写后的评测表面中仍然存在。第二，书面答案或经分数筛选的答案会安装这一能力，而优势加权分数（GRPO）虽提高奖励，却使模型在留出物理测试上与初始状态无统计差异——在所测试的配方和预算内，它只足以用于路由。经过训练的 8B 模型——首个处理空间结构响应的 LLM——达到该任务的数据精度前沿：在零样本和 32 样本条件下超过一个前沿 LLM，达到专用模型水平。标签对目标计算写明了什么，微调就教会什么；训练的内容决定了能够路由的内容。
items.author_line: Mingyu Li, Guorui Song, Jing Lin, Haoqian Wang

items.title: OmniHandwritingOCR: A Diagnostic Benchmark for Evaluating Multimodal LLMs in Handwritten OCR Scenarios
items.abstract_or_text: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are increasingly used as OCR systems in document and knowledge-processing pipelines, but their ability to faithfully read real handwriting remains underexplored. Existing OCR benchmarks focus largely on printed text or clean single-line inputs, leaving limited coverage of realistic handwritten OCR scenarios such as multilingual handwriting, writer errors, and structurally complex mathematical expressions. We introduce OmniHandwritingOCR, a diagnostic benchmark for evaluating MLLMs and OCR systems on handwritten OCR. It covers handwritten text recognition and handwritten mathematical expression recognition across six subtasks and twelve subsets, totaling 77.57K labeled images from public datasets and newly collected student writings. A key component is a difficulty-stratified multi-line formula corpus designed to test robustness under increasing structural complexity. We evaluate thirteen open- and closed-source systems with five complementary metrics under a unified protocol. Results show that current systems remain far from faithful transcription: performance drops sharply on complex multi-line formulas, model rankings vary across language and formula settings, and several generative models hallucinate plausible but visually unsupported corrections. OmniHandwritingOCR provides a challenging testbed for diagnosing language, content, structural, and visual-grounding failure modes of multimodal models in handwritten OCR scenarios.
items.summary_zh: OmniHandwritingOCR 用 77.57K 张标注图像，诊断多模态模型在手写文字和复杂多行数学表达式转写中的表现。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 统一协议下的多指标、跨难度与跨模型比较表明，复杂公式仍会显著降低转写保真度，不能以流畅的生成文本代替视觉识别结果。
items.abstract_zh: 多模态大语言模型（MLLM）日益被用作 OCR 系统，服务于文档和知识处理流程，但其忠实读取真实手写内容的能力仍未得到充分探索。现有 OCR 基准主要关注印刷文本或干净的单行输入，对多语言手写、书写者错误和结构复杂的数学表达式等真实手写 OCR 场景覆盖有限。我们提出 OmniHandwritingOCR：一个用于评估 MLLM 和 OCR 系统在手写 OCR 场景中表现的诊断基准。它覆盖六个子任务和十二个子集中的手写文本识别与手写数学表达式识别，共含 77.57K 张来自公开数据集和新收集学生书写材料的标注图像。其关键组成部分是一个按难度分层的多行公式语料，用于测试系统在结构复杂度提升时的稳健性。我们在统一协议下，采用五种互补指标评估十三个开源和闭源系统。结果显示，当前系统距离忠实转写仍有很大差距：复杂多行公式上的表现急剧下降，模型排名会随语言和公式设置而变化，若干生成式模型会产生看似合理但缺乏视觉支持的改写。OmniHandwritingOCR 为诊断 MLLM 在手写 OCR 场景中的语言、内容、结构和视觉依据失败模式提供了具有挑战性的测试平台。
items.author_line: Zinuo Guo, Min Zhang, Bo Jiang

items.title: Training-Free Inference-Time Self-Reflection and Cost-Bounded Early Stopping for Large Language Models
items.abstract_or_text: Reinforcement-learning training of reasoning LLMs (e.g., GRPO) is expensive and requires a controllable environment, committing every contribution to a full training pipeline. We present EvoResearcher, a training-free, inference-time protocol that adds cost-bounded self-reflection to a single frozen LLM backbone. The protocol iterates generate -> self-critique -> revise until a maximum depth D is reached or the critique returns the CONFIRMED sentinel, an implicit early stop that lets the backbone self-verify its answer under a strict compute budget. Four self-reflective meta-reward components (correctness, efficiency, reflection depth, tool-call diversity) act as design principles instantiated as prompt-level mechanisms, so their benefits accrue with zero gradient updates. We validate the protocol on Big-Bench Hard (100 questions) and establish cross-domain behavior on GSM8K (500) and MATH (500) on the same frozen backbone, with cross-model replication on Qwen2.5-72B. All experiments use pure-reasoning benchmarks; the tool-call diversity component is validated in prompt-level form, and the environment-level and multi-agent extensions are design blueprints left to future work. On clean BBH the protocol does not raise accuracy beyond the 95% Wilson interval; its value is cost-bounded self-verification, with the CONFIRMED early stop terminating 82-88% of items at equal accuracy (about 2.1 generations per question).
items.summary_zh: EvoResearcher 在冻结模型上以“生成—自我批评—修订”循环及早停标记，研究固定推理预算下的自我核查。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它明确报告在 BBH 上没有超出置信区间的准确率提升，同时给出 GSM8K、MATH 和跨模型复现实验，避免将节省生成次数表述为能力跃升。
items.abstract_zh: 推理 LLM 的强化学习训练（例如 GRPO）代价高昂，并且需要可控环境，使得每项贡献都必须投入完整训练流水线。我们提出 EvoResearcher：一种无需训练、在推理时运行的协议，为单个冻结 LLM 主干加入计算成本受限的自我反思。该协议反复执行“生成→自我批评→修订”，直至达到最大深度 D，或批评返回 CONFIRMED 标记；该隐式早停使主干能够在严格计算预算下自我核查答案。四个自反思元奖励组成部分（正确性、效率、反思深度、工具调用多样性）作为设计原则，以提示级机制实现，因此其收益无需进行梯度更新。我们在 Big-Bench Hard（100 题）上验证该协议，并在同一冻结主干上的 GSM8K（500 题）和 MATH（500 题）上建立跨领域行为，还在 Qwen2.5-72B 上进行跨模型复现。所有实验均使用纯推理基准；工具调用多样性组成部分以提示级形式验证，环境级和多智能体扩展仍是留待未来的设计蓝图。在干净的 BBH 上，该协议未将准确率提高到 95% Wilson 置信区间之外；其价值在于计算成本受限的自我核查，CONFIRMED 早停会在相同准确率下终止 82%–88% 的题目（约 2.1 次生成）。
items.author_line: Wei Yu, Suxing Liu, Minjie Yu, Jiahao Wang, Zhijian Zheng, Haocheng Deng, Bing Li

items.title: @ornith_：Aloha! 🌺Introducing Ornith-1.5, a family of open-source LLMs spanning 9B Dense, 35B MoE, and 397B MoE, trained with self
items.abstract_or_text: Aloha! 🌺Introducing Ornith-1.5, a family of open-source LLMs spanning 9B Dense, 35B MoE, and 397B MoE, trained with self-improving strategies. It achieves state-of-the-art performance among open-source models of comparable size and delivers performance comparable to Claude Opus 4.8 across reasoning, agentic, and coding tasks: ✅Terminal-Bench 2.1 (86.1) ✅SWE-Bench (86 on verified, 65.1 on pro, 79.6 on Multilingual) ✅DeepSWE (56) ✅HLE (44.6) ✅ClawEval (81.4) ✅Tool Decathlon (71.2) Ornith-1.5 takes a major step toward training foundation models through end-to-end self-improvement, extending the self-scaffolding strategies introduced in Ornith-1.0 into a more complete self-improvement loop: the model proposes new tasks, generates task-specific scaffolds, and produces solution rollouts for reinforcement learning, continuously creating new learning experiences from which it can improve. All models, along with their quantized versions (FP8, GGUF, MLX, and NVFP4), have been released under the MIT License, enabling unrestricted commercial and research use.
items.summary_zh: Ornith 发布 Ornith-1.5 开源模型家族，覆盖 9B 稠密、35B MoE 与 397B MoE 三种规模，并公布了推理、智能体和编程基准成绩。发布方称，其训练采用端到端自我改进循环，模型会提出任务、生成任务脚手架，并产出用于强化学习的解题轨迹。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 编辑判断：该发布同时涉及训练范式、模型权重和多种量化版本，信息密度较高；帖文中的性能比较仍应等待独立复现与统一评测。
items.abstract_zh: 阿罗哈！🌺推出 Ornith-1.5：一个采用自我改进策略训练的开源 LLM 家族，涵盖 9B 稠密、35B MoE 和 397B MoE。它在同等规模的开源模型中实现了最先进的性能，并在推理、智能体和编程任务上展现出可与 Claude Opus 4.8 相当的表现：✅Terminal-Bench 2.1（86.1）✅SWE-Bench（verified 为 86、pro 为 65.1、多语言为 79.6）✅DeepSWE（56）✅HLE（44.6）✅ClawEval（81.4）✅Tool Decathlon（71.2）。Ornith-1.5 朝着通过端到端自我改进训练基础模型迈出重要一步：它将 Ornith-1.0 引入的自脚手架策略扩展为更完整的自我改进循环，模型会提出新任务、生成任务专用脚手架，并为强化学习产生解题轨迹，不断创造可供自身改进的新学习经验。全部模型及其量化版本（FP8、GGUF、MLX 和 NVFP4）均已在 MIT 许可证下发布，可不受限制地用于商业和研究。
items.author_line: Ornith

items.title: @OpenAI：As models become more capable, the risks associated with developing and testing them internally also grow. We temporaril
items.abstract_or_text: As models become more capable, the risks associated with developing and testing them internally also grow. We temporarily paused reinforcement learning (RL) training on our latest models intended for deployment for two weeks while we hardened and red-teamed our research environments and expanded monitoring coverage. Our largest planned frontier RL run remains on hold while smaller-scale training and evaluations validate these safeguards and establish more evidence of alignment.
items.summary_zh: OpenAI 表示，为加强研究环境并扩展监测覆盖，其面向部署的最新模型强化学习训练暂停两周；计划中最大规模的前沿强化学习运行仍处于暂停状态。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 编辑判断：这是少见的研发过程公开说明，具体呈现了模型能力上升时，研究环境安全与对齐证据如何影响训练安排。
items.abstract_zh: 随着模型能力增强，在内部开发和测试它们时相关的风险也会增长。我们暂时暂停了面向部署的最新模型的强化学习（RL）训练两周，以加强研究环境的安全性并开展红队测试，同时扩大监测覆盖。我们计划中规模最大的前沿强化学习运行仍处于暂停状态；较小规模的训练和评估正在验证这些保障措施，并建立更多对齐证据。
items.author_line: OpenAI

items.title: @UnslothAI：We’re releasing new Qwen3.8-27B GGUFs with 10% higher accuracy. Unsloth Dynamic V3 outperforms others by >10% on Div-300
items.abstract_or_text: We’re releasing new Qwen3.8-27B GGUFs with 10% higher accuracy. Unsloth Dynamic V3 outperforms others by >10% on Div-300, KLD & more benchmarks. items.title: @RuxandraTeslo：Claude Science is an amazing tool. But, as @pdhsu has pointed out, these binders weren’t designed by Claude, but rather
items.abstract_or_text: Claude Science is an amazing tool. But, as @pdhsu has pointed out, these binders weren’t designed by Claude, but rather by domain-specific models, most of which are publicly available, like RFdiffusion. Maybe this is a good time to explain the whole science behind this a bit, as well as the history of these models. A “binder” in this case is simply a protein or a fragment of a protein engineered to stick tightly and selectively to another protein. We already have AI models that are very good at the task of binder design. One example is RFdiffusion, a de novo protein design model which was published in 2023. Unlike AlphaFold, which predicts existing protein structure from sequence, RFdiffusion can generate new candidate protein structures, including structures shaped to bind a specified patch on another protein. What Claude adds is still amazingly useful and labour saving, but it acts more like a very useful interface and orchestrator.
items.summary_zh: Ruxandra Teslo 认为，Claude Science 的价值应与领域专用蛋白设计模型区分开：蛋白结合体并非由 Claude 直接设计，RFdiffusion 等公开模型承担生成工作，Claude 更接近界面与编排角色。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 编辑判断：这则观点为“AI 科研”演示补充了工具链归因，提醒读者区分生成模型、领域知识与工作流编排各自的贡献。
items.abstract_zh: Claude Science 是一款很出色的工具。但正如 @pdhsu 指出的那样，这些结合体并非由 Claude 设计，而是由领域专用模型设计，其中大多数模型都是公开可用的，例如 RFdiffusion。或许现在正适合稍微解释一下背后的整个科学原理以及这些模型的历史。在这里，“结合体”只是指经过工程化处理、能够紧密且选择性地黏附到另一种蛋白质上的蛋白质或蛋白质片段。我们已经拥有很擅长结合体设计任务的 AI 模型。一个例子是 2023 年发表的从头蛋白质设计模型 RFdiffusion。与根据序列预测既有蛋白质结构的 AlphaFold 不同，RFdiffusion 可以生成新的候选蛋白质结构，包括被塑造成与另一种蛋白质指定表面结合的结构。Claude 带来的东西仍然非常有用且能节省劳动，但它的作用更像是一个非常有用的界面和编排者。

items.abstract_or_text: Anthropic benchmarked their newest Claude models on protein engineering tasks, and we at @adaptyvbio ran the wet lab work behind it. They picked 16 targets from our past protein design competitions on @proteinbase and sent us an anonymised list of designs, so we had no idea which model produced which sequence. We then ran those protein designs through our automated wet lab workflow to characterize protein expression and binding affinities. Here are the results: - 95% of the designs expressed, which three years ago would have been the headline on its own. - 354 of 1,320 designs bound their target on SPR, a 26.8% hit rate overall. Claude got binders on 14 of the 15 targets we could evaluate.

items.title: @jietang：Thoughts About Scaling Law Scaling, but not only of parameters. Every model release now ends with the same question: how
items.abstract_or_text: Thoughts About Scaling Law Scaling, but not only of parameters. Every model release now ends with the same question: how many parameters? It isn't a question that can be answered on its own. Parameter count is only meaningful alongside three others — how much data you have, where you intend to spend your compute, and who will run the model, under what conditions. The field learned this the hard way. Kaplan et al. (2020) fit an exponent that told everyone to grow parameters faster than data — roughly 2.7:1 — and the industry complied. Hoffmann et al. (2022) redid the experiment across four hundred models and found the compute-optimal split is closer to 20 tokens per parameter. Chinchilla wasn't the end either. Put inference into the objective and the optimum moves toward smaller models trained far longer. GLM-5.3 is our controlled experiment on that claim: same base, same architecture, same total and activated parameters as GLM-5.2, then one month of scaling long-horizon environments and RL.
items.summary_zh: Jie Tang 以 GLM-5.3 为例讨论缩放规律：参数量需与训练数据、计算资源分配和运行条件共同理解；他将其描述为一项在相同架构与参数规模下，延长长期环境与强化学习训练的受控实验。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 编辑判断：该帖文把常被简化为参数竞赛的模型比较放回训练数据、训练算力和推理成本的共同语境，形成了有实质内容的研究者观点。
evidence_flags: GLM实验细节待技术报告核验
items.abstract_zh: 关于缩放定律的思考：缩放，但不只看参数。如今每次模型发布都会以同一个问题结束：有多少参数？这个问题不能脱离其他信息单独回答。参数量只有与另外三项并列时才有意义——你拥有多少数据、准备把计算资源花在何处，以及谁会在什么条件下运行模型。这个领域是从艰难教训中学到这一点的。Kaplan 等人（2020）拟合出一个指数，告诉所有人参数应比数据增长得更快——约为 2.7:1——业界也照做了。Hoffmann 等人（2022）在四百个模型上重新进行了实验，发现计算最优的比例更接近每个参数 20 个词元。Chinchilla 也并非终点。把推理纳入目标函数后，最优点会移向训练时间更长、规模更小的模型。GLM-5.3 是我们针对这一主张的受控实验：与 GLM-5.2 使用相同的基础、相同的架构、相同的总参数和激活参数，然后用一个月扩展长期环境与强化学习。

items.abstract_or_text: Do LLMs know when they have enough information to answer, and what to ask a human when they don’t? @_yepeng We spend a lot of time developing agents that can answer the questions we ask them. But the reverse direction gets much less attention: when the prompt does not contain enough information, can a model recognize what is missing and ask for it? Paper: https://t.co/xlWmIwZ4Mt Project: https://t.co/tY06kTBsyp For agents that interact with humans, biological systems, or clinical workflows, we need to evaluate not only whether they can answer questions, but also whether they know what they need to know before answering.

items.abstract_zh: SYCL 更新修复量化 `cpy` kernel 启动时的线程和 block 数量，使其与量化块大小相匹配，减少资源不足或过度占用。官方说明称，在 Arc 70 上，q4_0 到 f32 路径的吞吐量从 20.21 GB/s 提高到 158.19 GB/s；其他量化格式的性能提升基本持平。

items.summary_zh: langchain-ai/langchain 发布 langchain-core==1.6.0，新增标准模型异常类型，强化严格工具 schema 校验，并延迟导入 transformers 以改善启动开销。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 构建 LangChain Agent、结构化工具调用或 Windows 开发环境的团队需要关注嵌套 schema 的更严格要求；延迟导入也可减少未使用 transformers 时的初始化负担。
items.abstract_zh: 相较 langchain-core==1.5.6，langchain-core==1.6.0 新增标准模型异常类型；修复 `StructuredTool._injected_args_keys` 的延后注解解析、`RunnablePick` 反序列化、`convert_to_openai_function` 对 callable 和非 dict mapping 的处理；工具 schema 序列化遇到无法解析的 forward reference 时会快速报错，严格工具 schema 现在要求所有嵌套属性；该版本还延迟导入 transformers，并修复 Windows 上的 subprocess 和临时文件测试可移植性。
